scope: Independent structural and browser integration validation; semantic source review remains separately documented.

data.scope: Structural provenance, source-ledger comparisons and known factual regressions; not a substitute for reading every court decision.
checks: All 131 retention candidates have exactly one matching judicial profile
Assessment values match the separately reviewed bar-source ledger
Voluntary polls, insufficient responses and institutional judgments stay distinct
Every selected ruling identifies the judge, legal act, appeal history and pinpointed primary source
No overall judicial political score; any policy comparison needs the exact issue and dated policy evidence
Election-party history stays dated and separate from the retention ballot
Published coverage counts describe actual profiles and rulings
